items.text: When a friendly lane minion or jungle monster dies, they drop a coin for you to collect that persists for 8 seconds. Picking one coin up grants you 1 gold and a soul stack. When you return to base, you lose all Soul Stacks and gain max health per stack lost. You can also Ferry 2 allies at a time who interact with him and pay 1 gold to him.
While being ferries allies take 50% of the damage you take as true damage. Any Stun, displacement, teleport, banish or grab will immediately eject all allies from the boat.

Fire a soul in a line that deals magical damage and slows all enemies, stopping on the first god hit. If the soul hits an enemy god, it explodes, dealing magical damage and silencing all enemies hit by the explosion, as well as causing all hit enemies to leave a trail behind them for 3 seconds.

After a short delay a burt of water from the Styx appears and deals magical damage to all enemies in the area. Enemy gods hit are marked for 3 seconds. The marked gods are revealed and have reduced attack speed. Additionally, any time an allied god hits a marked god, the ally gains a shield for 3 seconds.
Charge forward with increased movement speed and remain slow and displacement immune while charging. Any enemy you collide with, or that hits the wake of your boat takes magical damage and is rooted.

Gain CC immunity and summon a massive wave across the battlefield. Enemy gods hit by the wave take magical damage and are feared. Allied gods gain protections. Additionally all allies standing within the zone behind the wave are granted movement speed.

You now passively draw in coins dropped by your passive while they are within assist range. Damnation no longer applies an attack speed slow, nor marks a target to apply shield. Instead, it summons a soul to orbit enemy gods, which fires stygian energy at the god they are orbiting when you hit them with your abilities or basic attacks. Abilities cause three followup hits, while basic attacks cause one. This damage scales with the number of coins you have collected. Spectral Surge no longer silences targets, but refreshes the duration of the soul from the Damnation.

SMITE 2 flattened god Base Stats to improve flexibility. That worked, but it reduced some of the core differences between gods. We’re reintroducing some of that texture. Each god now has one standout base stat that fits their kit, like Kukulkan’s mana or Achilles’ physical protections. That makes gods feel more distinct without sacrificing flexibility.

We’re also making some changes focused on early laning. Mana management will matter more: all gods are losing base and per-level Mana regen. Attack Damage is going up on melee gods and gods with less ability-focused kits. Bruisers in Solo and tanks in Duo should be able to trade better into ranged casters and healer supports.
This is a long list. To see them go to this page:
Decreased STR or INT per stack of the first two Infamy tiers from +4 -> +3
Now only gains a stack once per ability hit
Fixed Enhanced Fire Giant buff granting Penetration
Increased the width of the lane up to 2m in some spots near the Tier 1 and Tier 2 Towers
Improved camera collision on the boundary of the map
Increased Minion spawn frequency from every 25s to 22s
Increased Minion scaling frequency from every 180s to 90s
Every 6 waves from 0s to 900s, now 0s to 600s
Every 5 waves from 900s to 1200s, now 300s to 900s
Every 4 waves from 1200s to 1500s, now 600s to 1200s
Fixed Fire Melee Minions granting more XP & Gold than intended
Added custom lobby for All Pick Assault
Match Boosters are now officially available.
These will provide 2x XP and Worshipers for you and your team, for one match
They can be purchased by one player on each team
They are priced for 300 Legacy Gems or 100 Diamonds
Decreased Bonus damage dealt to enemies below 50%: 0.5% -> 0.25% increased damage
Decreased Dash Scaling: 65% Intelligence + 65% Strength -> 55% Intelligence + 55% Strength
Decreased Damage Scaling: 65% Strength + 90% Intelligence -> 55% Strength + 70% Intelligence
Decreased Projectile Damage Scaling: 40% Strength + 8% Intelligence + 40% Attack Damage -> 30% Strength + 6% Intelligence + 30% Attack Damage
Decreased Heal Scaling Per Tick: 1.5% -> 1% Intelligence
Increased Max Mana from God kills and assists: 5 -> 20
Increased Max mana from jungle monster kills: 1 -> 2
Fixed: This ability can now be used while Crippled
Symbols are no longer removed on death
Increased Outer Area Damage Scaling: 30% -> 40% Intelligence
NEW: If an enemy god is affected by Mark of Body's Slow, it will also apply the corresponding Mark and Symbols.
Shroud of Wildfire description updated to include Jungle Bosses as a target that can proc area damage
Shroud of Wildfire's debuff should no longer trigger from Jumping
Consuming Power should no longer hit marked targets globally
While the Aspect is selected, Morgan Le Fay is properly tagged as Melee
Aspect Consuming Power now correctly expires when the duration times out
Aspect Consuming Power can now be used while Crippled
Fixed an issue where then final stage (Dash) would go on cooldown if you cancelled targeting of the dash.
Decreased Initial Damage: 1.25 Per Level + 4 -> 1 Per Level + 3
Fixed an issue where the AoE cleave was still doing bonus damage to jungle monsters
Removed: True damage dealt to minions
Increased Healing: 1.5% -> 2% of your Max Health
New Setting: Enable Prefire Targeters While Using Instant Cast
This will display your targeter during the prefire phase of an ability on Instant Cast. e.g. - Sun Wukong 1's ground targeter will be shown during the windup.
All Purchase Modals will now show how much currency you have on that modal.
Fixed Joust Towers disappearing before playing their full destruction animation
Squiggly Lines from Hou Yi 2 will no longer persist forever
Actually fixing the orbs on Nut and Artemis for real this time
Vulcan Turret Targeter will not cast a shadow in Joust
Fix Bumba’s Hammer dealing the incorrect damage to camps
Removed the “Fill” Option from Conquest Lobbies
You can still queue for fill, but you will be assigned a role when the lobby opens
You may trade other players for their roles, but you cannot switch your role to Fill
Fixed an issue that could cause Susano 1 to permanently break
Some tooltip translations for languages other than English are only in English. These will be fixed in the Gilgamesh release, on March 24.
